text:
Hi Mixers,
I just wanted to share a nice experience from Tel Aviv Branch today. 

Some context about us, we are a same sex couple, married for two years. 

Two days ago we went to submit our "center of life" documents and we went today to get my second A5 visa.

We arrived at 9:58 and at 10:00 we were called up. 

We went inside and got separated. The translator was there with me. I filed this first document saying that I understand what the interview is about, bla, bla, bla. I signed at a dotted line, the translator got sent home and my husband was invited back and we were told that the interview is over and my visa has been granted and my ID extended. 

Total, 6 minutes. I think some kind of a record. 😁.

The clerk said that she was very surprised to see us on the schedule, after a year, because in her opinion there is no need and that we should have been scheduled for one interview in 2 years. Because as she said: "we are not problematic", whatever that means.

I just wanted to share that it's not always doom and gloom and good things at Misrad HaPnim do happen. 😁

Best.
